verdict.rationale: Gladia documents an official CLI. You install it, set your key and run `gladia transcribe audio.mp3`. It writes plain text, JSON, SRT or VTT to stdout, gives pipe-friendly machine-readable output for scripts and CI, and generates shell completion for bash, zsh, fish and powershell. The probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as documented.
